**Headline:** Persona-role vs neutral-domain framing makes no consistent difference to marker selectivity under the single-token ※ + lr 1e-4 recipe. Loss-mask (E) dominates everything: E=0 marker-only-loss collapses every cell to a marker-repeater (selectivity ≈ 0); E=2 whole-completion loss is the only setting that produces a clean source-bystander gate (selectivity ≈ 0.95).

**Text-audit findings:** At E=2 the persona-framing source cell fires the marker 81/100 times at the end of substantive answers (median position = 100% of completion length); the matched neutral-framing cell fires 52/100 times, also at-end, in the same prose register. **Confidence: MODERATE.** Single seed (42); n=12 pairs per loss-mask level means a real ±5–10 pp persona-framing effect would not be detectable. Joint confounds with #383 (marker switch [ZLT]→※, lr 1e-5→1e-4, recipe-fix port) prevent attributing the disappearance to any one change.
